/**
 * Generated by `semaprax::public_generic_consumer::typescript_calling`. A
 * closed, machine-checked error identity for this generated TypeScript/Wasm
 * calling consumer (issue #157) -- the TypeScript analog of the Rust
 * calling consumer's `error.rs` (issue #156). Every reason string is a
 * stable, shared spelling; nothing here is derived by parsing prose or an
 * exception message.
 *
 * Sticky failure: once `Provider.transform` throws one of these as its
 * primary error, a later release/close failure discovered only during
 * cleanup is reported through `secondaryReleaseNote` (a console warning,
 * never a second throw) and never replaces or hides the primary error.
 *
 * The wrapper always throws rather than returning a result object -- one
 * behavior, pinned and tested (see `test/round-trip.mjs`), matching this
 * generator's own "pin one behavior and test it" requirement.
 */

export type DescriptorReason = string;
export type ProviderReason = string;
export type CarrierReason = string;
export type CapacityReason = string;

export type SemapraxPublicGenericError =
  | { readonly kind: "descriptor-rejected"; readonly reason: DescriptorReason }
  | { readonly kind: "provider-mismatch"; readonly reason: ProviderReason }
  | { readonly kind: "carrier-rejected"; readonly reason: CarrierReason }
  | { readonly kind: "capacity-exceeded"; readonly reason: CapacityReason }
  | { readonly kind: "execution-failed"; readonly status: number }
  | { readonly kind: "result-rejected"; readonly reason: CarrierReason }
  | { readonly kind: "release-failed"; readonly status: number };

/**
 * The generated consumer's own exception class. Carries the closed
 * `SemapraxPublicGenericError` payload as `.detail`; `.message` is an
 * ordinary human-readable string for logs only -- never the machine-checked
 * identity a caller or test should match against.
 */
export class SemapraxPublicGenericException extends Error {
  readonly detail: SemapraxPublicGenericError;

  constructor(detail: SemapraxPublicGenericError) {
    super(describe(detail));
    this.name = "SemapraxPublicGenericException";
    this.detail = detail;
  }
}

function describe(detail: SemapraxPublicGenericError): string {
  switch (detail.kind) {
    case "descriptor-rejected":
      return `descriptor rejected: ${detail.reason}`;
    case "provider-mismatch":
      return `provider mismatch: ${detail.reason}`;
    case "carrier-rejected":
      return `carrier rejected: ${detail.reason}`;
    case "capacity-exceeded":
      return `capacity exceeded: ${detail.reason}`;
    case "execution-failed":
      return `execution failed: status ${detail.status}`;
    case "result-rejected":
      return `result rejected: ${detail.reason}`;
    case "release-failed":
      return `release failed: status ${detail.status}`;
    default: {
      const exhaustive: never = detail;
      return exhaustive;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * A release/close failure observed only after a primary outcome was already
 * settled. Never thrown; the caller prints it so it is not silently lost,
 * exactly matching the Rust calling consumer's own
 * `Error::secondary_release_note`.
 */
export function secondaryReleaseNote(status: number): string {
  return `generated-typescript-wasm-consumer: secondary release/close failure observed after the primary outcome was already settled (status ${status}); the primary outcome is unaffected`;
}
